title: Phoretic colloids (SIM, new class): from a uniform random gas, two chemically non-reciprocal particle species self-assemble into Janus composites (an A body with a B cap) that self-propel 5-8 body lengths with the cap held; the reciprocal twin's composites travel at most 2.5
summary: world.py: 1400 A + 400 B overdamped soft disks in a periodic 128^2 box. A makes chemical c1, B makes c2 (quasi-static screened Poisson, FFT); each particle drifts with mu[s][k] grad c_k, mu = [[1,-1],[1,0.5]]: A coheres on c1 and flees c2, B is drawn to c1 and weakly to c2. So B sticks to an A body while pushing it away: an A body with a B cap on one side chases its own cap (Soto & Golestanian 2014). labkit packs on seeds 0 and 1 (400 frames, t=200): composites form by t~40 and the most travelled tracks are A bodies with a B cap moving 7.8 (seed 0, track 80) and 6.2 (seed 1, track 168) body lengths; 51 and 40 tracks move >= 1 body length. The matched reciprocal twin (mu_A2 = +1, A drawn to B; same seeds, grid, duration) forms round mixed clusters whose best tracks move 2.5 and 2.3 body lengths. The world's own dt halved (dt 0.01, 50 substeps) on seed 0: max 5.4 body lengths. Particle-level tracking (clusters.py, composites.txt, t=80-200, seed 0): 7 of 23 composites (B share 0.1-0.6, alive >= 50 t) move >= 3 cluster diameters net, 0 of 23 in the reciprocal twin. Nothing grows, divides or has a boundary layer: the cap is a body part, not a wall.

claims.statement: In runs from a uniform random gas (seeds 0 and 1), Janus composites (an A body carrying a B cap on one side) form by t~40 and self-propel in persistent lines for 5-8 body lengths with the cap held, driven only by the non-reciprocal chemical responses; the reciprocal twin's composites do not travel beyond 2.5 body lengths.
claims.track: seed 0, track 80 (pack/seed0/tracks.png row 1: an A body with a B cap from t=60 to t=200, 7.8 body lengths); seed 1, track 168 (6.2 body lengths)

controls_run.M: pack_recip/ (mu_A2 = +1: reciprocal attraction, same seeds 0 and 1, grid and duration): max 2.5 and 2.3 body lengths; particles_seed0_reciprocal.png and composites.txt (0 of 23 composites move >= 3 diameters vs 7 of 23)

limits: Known physics (Soto & Golestanian PRL 112:068301, 2014; Agudo-Canalejo & Golestanian PRL 123:018101, 2019): self-assembled active colloidal molecules; new only to the ledger. Individuals are clusters of tens of particles that exchange members and coarsen slowly by merging (labkit merge/split 4.3-4.9); the best travels are 100-170 t long, and many composites stall when their cap spreads around the body. Labkit's body length uses a blurred-density radius (3-4 px). One parameter point, 2 seeds plus a dt/2 run on seed 0; no particle-number or box-size test. No growth, division or boundary layer.
